title: Ruby on Rails Developer
summary: A Ruby on Rails developer builds and maintains web applications and APIs with the Rails framework, usually on the back end with a PostgreSQL or MySQL database. In India you often work in a product startup or a services team building for overseas clients, alongside front-end developers, testers and a product owner.
dailyDuties: Build features and APIs in Rails from user stories
Write and fix RSpec tests before merging
Fix slow database queries and background jobs
Debug production issues from logs and error reports
Join sprint calls and demos with the client
typicalTitles: Full Stack Ruby on Rails Developer

skills.expectation: Build and maintain Rails apps with ActiveRecord, background jobs and clean MVC code
Design tables and write queries in PostgreSQL or MySQL
Build JSON APIs for web and mobile clients
Write RSpec or Minitest tests and practise TDD
Work in a pull-request workflow on Git
Apply object-oriented design and common design patterns
Work directly with overseas clients and product owners
Find N+1 queries and slow SQL and fix them
Use Redis for caching and job queues
Write Rails views with HTML, CSS and Hotwire
Deploy and run apps on AWS

certifications.why: Shows you can deploy and run apps on AWS
